Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
PrivateBank, PrivateBankAlt
public interface Bank
Interface for a generic bank. Provides multiple methods to handle the interaction between accounts and transactions.

  • Methodendetails

    • createAccount

      void createAccount(String account) throws AccountAlreadyExistsException
      Adds an account to the bank.
      Parameter:
      account - the account to be added
      Löst aus:
      AccountAlreadyExistsException - if the account already exists

    • createAccount

      void createAccount(String account, List<Transaction> transactions) throws AccountAlreadyExistsException, TransactionAlreadyExistException, TransactionAttributeException
      Adds an account (with specified transactions) to the bank. Important: duplicate transactions must not be added to the account!
      Parameter:
      account - the account to be added
      transactions - a list of already existing transactions which should be added to the newly created account
      Löst aus:
      AccountAlreadyExistsException - if the account already exists
      TransactionAlreadyExistException - if the transaction already exists
      TransactionAttributeException - if the validation check for certain attributes fail

    • addTransaction

      void addTransaction(String account, Transaction transaction) throws TransactionAlreadyExistException, AccountDoesNotExistException, TransactionAttributeException
      Adds a transaction to an already existing account.
      Parameter:
      account - the account to which the transaction is added
      transaction - the transaction which should be added to the specified account
      Löst aus:
      TransactionAlreadyExistException - if the transaction already exists
      AccountDoesNotExistException - if the specified account does not exist
      TransactionAttributeException - if the validation check for certain attributes fail

    • removeTransaction

      void removeTransaction(String account, Transaction transaction) throws AccountDoesNotExistException, TransactionDoesNotExistException
      Removes a transaction from an account. If the transaction does not exist, an exception is thrown.
      Parameter:
      account - the account from which the transaction is removed
      transaction - the transaction which is removed from the specified account
      Löst aus:
      AccountDoesNotExistException - if the specified account does not exist
      TransactionDoesNotExistException - if the transaction cannot be found

    • containsTransaction

      boolean containsTransaction(String account, Transaction transaction)
      Checks whether the specified transaction for a given account exists.
      Parameter:
      account - the account from which the transaction is checked
      transaction - the transaction to search/look for

    • getAccountBalance

      double getAccountBalance(String account)
      Calculates and returns the current account balance.
      Parameter:
      account - the selected account
      Gibt zurück:
      the current account balance

    • getTransactions

      List<Transaction> getTransactions(String account)
      Returns a list of transactions for an account.
      Parameter:
      account - the selected account
      Gibt zurück:
      the list of all transactions for the specified account

    • getTransactionsSorted

      List<Transaction> getTransactionsSorted(String account, boolean asc)
      Returns a sorted list (-> calculated amounts) of transactions for a specific account. Sorts the list either in ascending or descending order (or empty).
      Parameter:
      account - the selected account
      asc - selects if the transaction list is sorted in ascending or descending order
      Gibt zurück:
      the sorted list of all transactions for the specified account

    • getTransactionsByType

      List<Transaction> getTransactionsByType(String account, boolean positive)
      Returns a list of either positive or negative transactions (-> calculated amounts).
      Parameter:
      account - the selected account
      positive - selects if positive or negative transactions are listed
      Gibt zurück:
      the list of all transactions by type
